definitions.full: H1799. dikrown [ דִּכְרוֺן ] noun [masculine] memorandum, record (Biblical Hebrew זִכָּרוֺן , √ זָכַר ; compare Nabataean, Palmyrene דבר(ו)ן Lzb 268 SAC 40 Cooke 234 +); — emphatic דִּכְרוֺנָה Ezra 6:2 . [ דָּכְרָן ] noun [masculine] id.; — plural emphatic דָּכְרָנַיָּא סְפַר Ezra 4:15 (twice in verse).
